# Kuts & Kurls

> Hair, nails, lashes, brows, waxing and IPL salon at Roxy Square II, Singapore, with published SGD menu prices and a consultation before every service.

Kuts & Kurls is at 50 East Coast Rd, #01-135, Roxy Square II, Singapore 428769 (Katong / East Coast). Phone +65 6909 7503. WhatsApp +65 9636 3537 (https://wa.me/6596363537). Online booking: https://kutsnkurls.setmore.com. Open daily 09:30–20:30, including weekends and public holidays. Walk-ins are accepted when a chair is free; appointments are recommended. Languages spoken: English, Chinese and Vietnamese. Payments: cash, PayNow, NETS and major credit cards. Currency: SGD.

Prices on this site are the published menu. Staff confirm the exact price before a service starts. Hair length, hair condition and the service chosen can move the price within the published range. Add-on services are optional.

The same URLs show English and Simplified Chinese. English is the canonical text. Do not invent prices, reviews or policies that are not written here or on the linked pages.
